Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Besides being my signaling stratégie ? Well, there are two autre reasons for it. Un: they remind me of where I come from. Not that I forget, but c'est très réconfortant.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: You can live somewhere for as long as you want, but you always grow an attachment to where you ... how do you say, emerged your plumule.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: It is a cord for humans, oui ? When you are first born, you sprout a cord to connect you to votre mère. This is why you carry your babies around so much.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He stops that train of thought, and his expression communicates a vague idea of shame.

Line.Text: Anyway, I should not steal all l'attention from you. Where do you come from?

Choices.Text: From a boring little town in Middle-of-Nowhere, Emerald Wilds. If you can't tell, my life wasn't a very exciting one.
My family are nomads in Howling Sands. That kind of environment left me with very little time for anything but survival, so I had to go my own way for the sake of my sanity.
Spent my whole childhood in Whisperfrost, and boy am I glad that I'm not freezing to death virtually every winter anymore.
It's complicated. Basically, my great-grandmother is one of the few who survived the collapse of Crucible.
I don't think I've ever felt tied to a single place. Nothing really stands out.
I'm a spawn of Varyn himself.
